_note: Hand-kept contract and pay facts shown on driver profiles. Teams don't publish contract terms and salaries are media estimates, so fill a field only from a source you trust and always give that source: the app shows it next to the figure. Keys are driver ids (as in web/data/season_*.json). Example entry: "max_verstappen": {"contract_until": 2028, "contract_source": "https://...", "contract_source_name": "Red Bull press release", "salary_usd": 60000000, "salary_year": 2026, "salary_source": "https://...", "salary_source_name": "Forbes"}. Leave out anything you don't have.
